Nearly six years ago, after I had just begun my journey in robotics, I was drawn to a large number of areas relating to decision making in general.
One such area was imitation learning: something I knew very little about.
This was long before [Diffusion Policies](https://diffusion-policy.cs.columbia.edu/) popularized behavior cloning (?) in the robotics community.
